annotations.text:
Porchlight — warm modern direction.
Cream surfaces, one amber accent, Newsreader titles, Source Sans body.
No karma, no rankings anywhere. Anonymous authors show the porch raccoon.
Queue: flagged items blurred + grayscale, click to reveal. Locked items are never shown — only an escalation view with metadata. Duty checklist is region-gated (D17).
Settings: export sits right above erase, on purpose (D5/D6). Claim flow for anonymous posts uses the cookie first, then a pasted code (D7).
